name: After § 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text: 6a. Stresses that the drone incidents affecting Romania, the Baltic states, Finland and Greece are not merely military accidents but also consequences of the absence of any functioning diplomatic framework capable of containing the conflict; recalls that wars without political tracks do not remain geographically or operationally constrained; warns that every week that goes by without a credible negotiation process is a week in which the probability of an uncontrolled escalatory incident increases;
